selection: All 65 ChartQA and 110 VSR records in existing full validation; no prompt selection by results
step0_status: Reconstructed initialization, not original saved checkpoint
instruction: Represent the supplied content for retrieval along each fixed evidence direction.

original: Written text, numbers and quantitative evidence
paraphrase: Identify the entities and the meaning of the content
Describe visual appearance, properties and materials
Capture written information, numeric values and quantities

chartqa: Chart title, topic, legend entries and named data series
Colors and visual markers that identify chart categories and series
Axis labels, tick positions and alignment between marks and categories
Exact numeric values, units, scales, differences, totals and comparisons
vsr: The subject and reference object named in the spatial statement
Visual attributes that distinguish the subject from other objects
The directed spatial relation of the subject to the reference object
Visual evidence supporting or contradicting the stated spatial relation

fixed: Four slots in original slot order
comparisons: Both query and candidates use the same task-fixed basis; requires rebuilding the task index
Only query basis changes, original candidate vectors retained; no reindexing
Full query versus text-only with identical candidate vectors
Raw pretrained branches versus reconstructed Step 0 head versus Step 250 head
primary_contrasts: specialized minus original full R1 within each source and model
specialized minus original VSR balanced accuracy
secondary_contrasts: specialized visual contribution minus original visual contribution
prompt benefit at Step 250 minus prompt benefit at reconstructed Step 0
inference: Exploratory, motivated by observed weak validation scores; all arms reported, no best prompt selection. Paired query bootstrap intervals are descriptive and unadjusted.
claim_boundary: May demonstrate frozen task-prompt adaptation. These training sources and validation examples are already known; cannot establish unseen-task generalization or publication-level novelty. No query-specific or answer-dependent choice construction.
